decisions: Week view is primary; recurring templates and dated sessions are separate entities.
Template occurrence generation requires an explicit date; no automatic horizon is assumed.
Overbooking requires scheduling.override_capacity and is audited.
Booking eligibility remains server-owned and fails closed by default until client-plan assignments and available-balance data are integrated.
Reservation eligibility tests use an injected resolver; no real financial consumption is implemented.

reviewer_instructions: Review the exact final PR head; do not merge this PR.
